bootstrap.interval: percentile over defined resamples (stats.interval); Table B's contrast rows also give the registered bootstrap-t interval (prereg.studentise, unadjusted 95%)
bootstrap.resampling: unstratified bootstrap of clusters of base questions on the frozen cluster map (prereg §4.1, the design log; prereg.ClusterMap.resampling), on the confirmatory call's own bank index and matrix (bank_resampler), shared by every cell

estimands.label_rate: the conformance label AT FLAG LEVEL: the source flags the mutant (status F) and does not flag the same question's untouched gold; the same forms. The registered label (prereg 2b, the design log) is violation-level: whether the mutated query raises a violation under that source that the gold does not. A flag is the checker's verdict on the whole query, so this is the label the bank matrix can give, not the violation-level one the frozen bank (built with no source) does not hold
estimands.random_flagger: exactly the source's F of the population's N items, uniformly without replacement (trivial_checkers.random_flags, label = by_model|graph|bank|bank|replay|source, and |with_question_text on the question-text population); expected recall = flag rate; its intervals are conditional on this one fixed draw (the bootstrap resamples clusters, not the draw); on the type-consistent row it flags round(q N) of its N descriptive items, q the source's flag rate over the main bank population of the table
estimands.recall: pooled W_F / W over the cell's items (metrics.METRICS['recall']); only status F is a flag, an unknown or a pass stays in the denominator
estimands.recall_empty: the pooled ratio over the items whose checked query returned no rows (result_rows = 0); each row's empty_share is the share of its items that return no rows (§4.1, the design log)
estimands.recall_non_empty: the pooled ratio over the items whose checked query returned rows (result_rows > 0)
estimands.recall_per_question: the §4.1 estimand: the mean over base questions that have an item of the cell, of the question's flagged share; equal weight per base question (prereg._share)
